notes.title: One Year Anniversary!
notes.notes:
A New Planet!

That is because update 1.1.0 beta (Beachtopia Update) is out now!

I hope you enjoy the beach.


It has been 1 year since Super Kittens was first released to Steam.

So the next major update should stop you from being bored out of your mind with going to a new planet that is 100% beach and you have new things to try out and use for your new mission.

notes.title: Epic and funny things that happened while in development of Super Kittens 1.0.0 beta!
notes.notes:
Main menu scratched disk glitch:

When you would be on the main menu of the game the music would get stuck and repeats very fast and you couldn't do anything on the main menu at all.
I had to Ctl + Alt + Delete to exit, but the glitch is no more.


Auto activated cuteness bar:

The cuteness bar would start going down as soon as you entered the game.
That glitch is no more.


Codeable music

I was listening to some tunes when I was programming Super Kittens and songs based on code played.
